name: Beta 0.25.0.136
notes: World kits, stage 2: every world has its own miners and mine: laser miners at an open pit on rocky worlds, tracked crawlers ladling from a magma channel on molten worlds, snowcats at a steaming thermal bore on ice worlds, scoop drones diving under a floating cloud scoop on gas giants, submersible skimmers at a dredge rig on ocean worlds, and six-legged walkers at a glowing bioleach pond on living worlds

log.t: World kits, stage 2: every world has its own miners and mine: laser miners at an open pit on rocky worlds, tracked crawlers ladling from a magma channel on molten worlds, snowcats at a steaming thermal bore on ice worlds, scoop drones diving under a floating cloud scoop on gas giants, submersible skimmers at a dredge rig on ocean worlds, and six-legged walkers at a glowing bioleach pond on living worlds

World kits, stage 1: every colony now sits on one compact plot around its landing pad (mine to the north, refinery south-east, settlement south-west), placed on suitable ground (open sea on ocean worlds, a clearing on living worlds, a calm band on gas giants); landmarks keep clear of the whole plot, and the ground under it is cleared
Ocean worlds have less land: just a few small islands

Every planet type now has its own close-up features: volcanoes erupting on molten worlds, Jupiter-like bands, swirls and storms on gas giants, frozen lakes and snowy peaks on ice worlds, boulder fields on rocky worlds; five gas giants became new worlds: three ocean worlds with rolling waves (Pearlsea, Nerida, Undine) and two living worlds with forests and flowers (Verdance, Sylvan)

Settlements now match their planet: floating sky-cities with light-bridges on gas giants, ice-glass domes and crystal spires on icy worlds, heat-shielded domes on stilts beside lava pools on molten worlds; gas-giant miners hover
Planet rings are far more detailed: dozens of ringlets, gaps, shading from inner to outer edge, the planet's shadow across them and small glinting rocks up close
A glowing nebula now fills the sky behind the stars: a band of gas with dark dust lanes and three bright clouds in magenta, teal and gold
Messages now appear in the middle of the open view above the panel, never over the planet list
The Version card now says updates come out by 8 am Central

Code review tidy-ups: faster daily updates on the web (the 3D engine and sky picture are cached separately), pinch-zoom allowed for easier reading, numbers like 9,999 read 9.99 K and losses keep their minus sign, plus code clean-up

Fixes from the code review: messages queue instead of covering each other, long absences count every probe, the panel updates in place (keeps focus and is lighter), a new galaxy forgets the old one's plans, and time away uses the same model as live play

Fixes from the code review: no more late-game freezes from the Best parking spot ranking (worked out a little each frame, refreshed when anything changes), the offline copy can't be replaced by an error page, and saves that can't be read are backed up instead of overwritten
Warp tab: Galaxy value (what this galaxy is worth and what a warp would bring), plus This galaxy and All time statistics with recent warps
Recenter now glides smoothly back to the whole galaxy over about two seconds instead of jumping
After Balance sets the furnaces, each furnace's ore list glides to the ore it picked
The Market tab turns amber while a Market Surge is ready and teal while one runs
Fixed: a week's third mission now becomes Elite when a mission claimed before the events update counts as one of the two wins; a third mission already running is upgraded
Planet list buttons get their red and green status colours back, and sit on the panel's see-through background above the page
Planet list buttons look like the Smelter's ore buttons (grey, orange when selected) and no longer zoom on a double-tap
Prospecting's probe boost is now 1% per planet with no cap on the number of planets
Prospecting no longer steers probes toward a planet's ore; instead each planet with it makes probe hauls 2% bigger, up to 5 planets (+10%)
The station has its own blue on the map and in the Station tab, and still turns orange when research is ready
The Probe tab's name turns teal like the probe icon while the probe is out
Tabs that need you now turn their name orange instead of showing a dot; the Probe tab turns orange while the probe is out
Three zoom levels (the first further back, the third unchanged); stepping out goes to the galaxy view centred on the planet, and tapping a planet on the galaxy map drifts the view to centre on it

Events overhaul: mission goals sized to your own pace, up to three missions a week (the third an Elite one), a weekly streak bonus, and galaxy events every 12 hours: ore rushes, solar storms, comet passes and derelict freighters, each with a challenge
Station parking in credits: the move window shows income now, after the move, and after a free Balance, plus fuel payback; a Best parking spot card on the Station tab ranks where to park
Recenter now works like the Music button: lit orange when the view isn't the whole galaxy, grey when it is
Cards keep one size as their messages change: the probe card, station orbit, tuning chart status, mission tags, version card and all buttons
Tapping the credits skips a number style that would look the same (Named and Letters match below a quadrillion), so every tap changes it
Status icons sit closer together and a little higher, slightly larger
Probe and Market Surge status move into their tabs; under the credits, their icons (▲ ◈, in tab order) stay grey and light up when a surge is ready or the probe is out
Smelter: furnace cards keep one fixed layout, so picking an ore never moves the page, and every furnace shows one clear status line: Full speed, Slowed, Paused or Off
Every sideways list glides the item you pick to the middle, smoothly: planets, tabs, crews and furnace ores
Probe tab: tap 'Space probe' to zoom, like planet and station names; no more zoom buttons
Station tab: 'Parked at …' now sits under the station's name
The Research tab is now the Station tab: tap the station's name to zoom, and research sits in its own Research card
Planet tab: the zoom button is gone; tap the planet's name in the card to zoom, with the level line sliding under the name

Smelting is now a steady flow with bars/min and busy % per furnace, the Smelter gets a Balance window that picks the best ore for each furnace (research bars first if you like), and its dot only shows when something needs you
Tapping a planet's name in the panel flies to that planet's Close-up when you're not zoomed in
